purpose: The collector's own words for the front page. This is the only place on the site where the collector speaks; gallery, wing and artwork text never quotes or paraphrases it.
source: Collector message in the curation session, 2026-10-15
paragraphs: I discovered nnxyz's work on [nifty.ink](https://nifty.ink/), the early Ethereum ink-drawing platform. The images drew me in immediately. The work had energy and emotion. I would follow the chaotic lines and find details and stories that weren't visible at first glance. Over time I acquired four complete collections that span a range of techniques and subjects.

I always intended to share these collections. I wanted to give them a proper home where the art could be experienced fully, including the rare ability to watch each image being drawn, stroke by stroke. AI made that possible. It helped me work with the archived stroke files to replay each drawing and render it at a quality nifty.ink never could.
This site is a tribute to nnxyz's creative vision. I hope you enjoy exploring it. There is much here to observe, to appreciate, and perhaps most importantly, to feel.
markdownNote: The first paragraph carries one Markdown link to nifty.ink; render it as a link.
